candidates.name: Warm-Coffee Textured Button-Up
candidates.decisionReason: The jacquard surface is interesting, but the long dropped-shoulder overshirt, patch pocket, base-tee dependency and backpack styling do not prove Luxury fabric, finishing or Office construction.

candidates.name: Light-Khaki Textured Henley Knit
candidates.decisionReason: A product form cannot prove Luxury yarn, shoulder line, torso drape, sleeve behavior or hem recovery. The clean idea is insufficient without worn material evidence.

candidates.name: Dusty-Blue Corduroy Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The dusty blue is useful, but the shirt is shown only as a long open casual layer with a cap and T-shirt; Luxury cloth and finishing are not visually established.

candidates.name: Gray Fine-Stripe Button-Down
candidates.decisionReason: The open-over-tee overshirt proportions, broad dropped shoulder, denim styling and flat gray stripe are mass-market Casual rather than Luxury Office.

candidates.name: Coffee Contrast-Stitch Overshirt
candidates.decisionReason: Large workwear patch pockets, contrast stitching and the long open body communicate utility Casual, not Luxury hand-finishing or refined Office drape.

candidates.name: Moss Twin-Pocket Cotton Overshirt
candidates.decisionReason: The boxy twin-pocket utility shirt lacks the material refinement, exact proportion and self-contained styling required for Luxury Office.

candidates.name: Muted-Blue Twin-Pocket Cotton Overshirt
candidates.decisionReason: Color alone cannot elevate the same long utility-overshirt construction; its flap pockets, broad body and base layer remain casual and mass-market.

candidates.name: Creamy-White Corduroy Overshirt
candidates.decisionReason: The creamy color and corduroy are attractive, but the very broad long body and oversized twin pockets create heavy utility volume rather than Luxury Office precision.

candidates.name: Army-Green Corduroy Wide-Leg Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The product-only balloon-taper trouser with rolled cuffs supplies no worn rise, drape or shoe-break proof and cannot establish Luxury tailoring.

candidates.name: Camel Wide-Leg Casual Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The broad cotton leg visibly folds and pools over chunky sneakers; its everyday construction and hem collapse are incompatible with Luxury Office.

candidates.name: Gray Drawstring Straight Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: A gathered waistband, oversized exposed drawcord, D-ring and synthetic sheen read lounge or technical casual, not Luxury tailoring.

candidates.name: Army-Green Corduroy Snap Jacket
candidates.decisionReason: The product-only utility jacket combines patch pockets, exposed silver hardware and an elastic hem without worn drape or Luxury construction proof.

candidates.name: Brown Snap-Down Light Layer
candidates.decisionReason: The broad product form, storm-flap pockets and mixed technical hardware offer neither worn proportion evidence nor Luxury tailoring.

candidates.name: Green Striped Button-Up Cardigan
candidates.decisionReason: The product image depicts a narrow fitted torso and sleeves with retro striping; it is not a modern Luxury layer.

candidates.name: Khaki Zip-Up Light Jacket
candidates.decisionReason: Fleece collar, sleeve zip, patch label, synthetic shell and elastic hem make this a utility bomber, not Luxury Office outerwear.

candidates.name: Army-Green Zip-Up Light Jacket
candidates.decisionReason: The shiny product-only basic bomber offers no worn fit or Luxury textile evidence, and its black zips plus rib trims remain casual.

candidates.name: Military-Green Zip-Up Light Jacket
candidates.decisionReason: The corduroy bomber uses utility pockets, sleeve hardware and dark synthetic lining without any worn drape or Luxury finish proof.

candidates.name: Khaki Lightweight Zip Jacket

candidates.name: Khaki Double-Breasted Trench
